decisions.reason: The skin and hair supplement was publicly launched as new in pharmacies and fits the firm's announced consumer health expansion, so the prior commitment favors persisting despite no recent website evidence.

As part of the established Trivital brand line, the joint supplement carries brand-level commitment and low incremental cost, so management would keep it and attribute any weakness to temporary market conditions.
The mushroom immune supplement had only low visibility, but immune products likely gained from pandemic-era demand, which gives management grounds to keep it for now.

The OTC triptan got its own page and is part of the announced broadening of the portfolio, and the investment behind the switch product argues for persisting even though it is distant from the core offer.
